previous_runs.prompt: Observe the actual moving person and equipment. Select the exercise in these frames. Lat pulldown: a seated person pulls an OVERHEAD handle DOWN toward upper chest, returns UP; the torso stays seated while arms move overhead and down. Chest press: handles pushed FORWARD from chest height, not pulled down from overhead. Shoulder press: barbell or separate dumbbells pushed UP from shoulders. Triceps extension: upper arms remain near the head, weight moves BEHIND head. Pull-up: BODY moves toward a fixed bar, not pulling a handle down to a stationary seated torso. Bench press lies on a bench. Y raise uses nearly straight arms lifting diagonally. Do not infer from captions. Imperfect technique still belongs to its exercise. Choose 0 for rest, setup, static grip without exercise movement, none of the listed actions, or unclear. Reply ONE listed code only.
